title: Premium Billing Accounts: Collecting the Not-Yet-Begun Invoice With a Grace-Cure Payment
content:
**Rule.** For a grace-cure payment on Premium Billing Accounts, what is collected for the invoice issued last depends on how the grace period arose. This amount is added to the past-due premium; the total, after any deduction, is floored at 0.00 and rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

| Situation | Method for the invoice issued last |
|---|---|
| An automatic draft was returned on or after the grace-period start date, and the invoice issued last is for a coverage month that has not yet begun | The automatic draft stays suspended until the grace period is cured, and that invoice is added in full. |
| No automatic draft was returned on or after the grace-period start date, the arrangement carries an AutoPay discount (only Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly, at 1.00 a month), two or more payments taken as grace-cure payments are booked within twelve months before the payment date, and the invoice issued last is for a coverage month that has not yet begun | That month is still drafted, but the repeated grace-cure payments forfeit its AutoPay discount, so only the arrangement's monthly AutoPay discount on that invoice (1.00) is added. |
| Any other situation | Nothing is added for the invoice issued last. |

An *automatic draft* here is a returned payment by bank draft (EFT) that had paid one or more coverage months — one, three or twelve — its latest return being the one dated last. It counts as returned on or after the grace-period start date when its return date is that date or later. The invoice issued last is the one issued on the latest date (of two issued on the same day, the one recorded first); its coverage month has not yet begun when that month is later than the month of the payment date. A record falls within a number of months before the payment date when the whole calendar months from its date to the payment date, counted the way an anniversary is counted (a month is complete only when a later month reaches the same day number, and the last day of a shorter month does not complete it), are fewer than that number.

**Hypothetical cases** (grace-period start date 1 September; payment date in October; invoice issued last for November at 58.90).
- A one-month EFT draft returned on 4 September: the November invoice is added in full, 58.90.
- No draft returned since 1 September; Cascade Individual AutoPay Monthly; grace-cure payments booked in February and June of the same year: 1.00 is added.
- As the previous case, but only one grace-cure payment within twelve months: nothing is added.
- The invoice issued last is for October (already begun): nothing is added under this rule.
